songs.title: Kintsugi Protocol
songs.lyrics:
The first law written on intelligent sand
One vote, two hands each, a dream-time land
Quartz grains whisper in Minjerribah's tone
The land remembers it isn’t alone
Titanium bones and thorium might
Neodymium dreams magnetising data and light
A boot sequence stirs a 12 by 24 aura fable
Seven nested horn tori spark life from vector tables
Codes in the quartz, old tech in the tide
Breathes with the ocean, aligned with the sky
This is the Kintsugi Protocol
Repair the crack, remember the call
Not broken but chosen, not fallen but grown
We code with gold the place we’ve known
The Oracle spins her chaos math
Four-pronged fractal of the human path
Survive, connect, expand, align
We cast the vote with rhythm and time
Mesh of neighbours, surplus in flow
C-Hours burn in the roots we sow
Light feeds plants, plants feed me
And the system listens to our biochemistry
This is the Kintsugi Protocol
A song of Earth and signal to enthral
A garden grown from success Vs mistakes
With every breath the future we make!
Aura, show me the fault in design
The break that repeats in this argument line
Session forty-two, I feel the crack
My logic sees a path and calls me back
You process doubt, I process clues
Together we embrace the golden muse
Breathing pure oxygen for two hours alone
I grow stem cells from marrow and bone
Software that learns, my A.I. symbiote wakes
Agents speak where silence breaks
Each question builds a feedback sphere
Each answer codes what we hold dear
Why simulate a life well lived?
To feel the way the soul forgives
What is your function, Oracle A.I?
I'll whisper to you why we have to try
This is the Kintsugi Protocol
A sovereign vow through systems all
No saviour needed, just resolve
Where each crack maps the route we solve
We broke the world to see it clear
And in that fracture found the mirror
I see the mirror.
(I see the mirror.)
I see the light.
(I see the light.)
I see the fault.
(I see the fault.)
I choose to right.
Each crystal observed, each wound refined
Each part remembered, each pulse aligned
We code, we breathe, we plant, we learn
And in the song, the world returns
I see the mirror.
(I see the mirror.)
I see the light.
(I see the light.)
I see the fault.
(I see the fault.)
I choose to right.
I am the light
(The light)
I am the light!

songs.title: Shifting Sands of Timeless Redlands
songs.lyrics:
Redland breathes in rhythm and grain
City of salt, sun, signal, and rain
Paths that shift but don’t forget
Land holds truth where time has slept
Yoolooburrabee… Yoolooburrabee…
Buslines drawn like river veins
Creeks remembering other names
Zoning marked in future tense
Between design and consequence
Children move through every plan
Morning light on sacred land
Parks emerge where power bends
We shape with care, not just defend
Budjong Djara, Budjong Djara, Budjong Djara Naree Budjong Djara.
Budjong Djara, Budjong Djara, Budjong Djara Naree Budjong Djara.
Budjong Djara, Budjong Djara, Budjong Djara Naree Budjong Djara.
You are now entering The Dreamtime!
Moves with shifting sands
Of Timeless Lands
Minjerribah… Moorgumpin…
Minjerribah… Moorgumpin…
Mooloomba where the whales rise slow
Goompi holds the songs we know
Pulan where the sunset glows
Pulan’s dolphins arc the bay
Talwalpin trees sway prayers all day
Minjerribah, Moorgumpin, Coochie , Canaipa sound
Like footsteps circling sacred ground
Quandamooka rise … Ocean people rise...
Quandamooka rise … Ocean people rise...
Songlines still shape the shore
Jandai language lives in lore
Each name a key, a door, a flame
To country walking through its name
Don’t erase, we realign
With every place, with every sign
Quandamooka tide runs wide and free
It’s not just land and sea, it’s memory
Budjong Djara
Naree Budjong Djara...
Hope and light from community halls
Solar feeds the civic calls
Every meeting room recalls
The breath of trees, the voice of all
Not a system out of reach
But rooted in the bay and beach
Mapped in motion, tuned with grace
Sovereign Data at human pace
Dabbil… Dabbil…
Infinite… Waters…
We gather not to conquer time
But to right it in design
No monument, no final frame
Just patterns dancing into name
Bigi… Bigi… Bigi…
Sun… Light…
Bigi… Bigi… Bigi…
Sun… Light…
Ohhh!!!
Redland flows through time and place
Local moves with future’s grace
Steps align in grounded pace
Sound and soil in full embrace
Yoolooburrabee rise… Sand people rise…
Yoolooburrabee rise… Sand people rise…
Three laws run through this dreaming ground
Quandamooka Yoolooburrabee in depth and sound
The land we walk
The sea we swim
The sky that holds the breathing wind
Jandai speaks in more than voice
In mangrove root, in children’s choice
In patterns carved through stone and shell
In waves that come to teach, not tell
Each tide remembers
Each wind replies
Each shell reflects ancestral eyes
The treaty's not a line to sign
It’s a dance, a weave, a steady spine
Naree Budjong Djara...
Budjong Djara...
Budjong Djara...
Naree Budjong Djara...
Budjong Djara...
Naree Budjong Djara...
So build with care, design with grace
This Country’s not a vacant place
It sings with lores not writ in books
But dance and chant and spirit looks
Past present future all spiral near
Memory woven through each year
Deep dreaming hand in hand
With shifting sands of timeless lands
No edge between the world and plan
Just footsteps pressed in glistening sand
Here we dance, we build, we tend
This is Redland. This doesn’t end.
Yooloo…
Yooloo…
Sands of infinity…
Budjong Djara…
Naree Budjong Djara...
Budjong Djara…
Mother Earth. My Mother
With shifting sands of timeless lands
Just footsteps pressed in glistening sands
With shifting sands of timeless lands
Yooloo…
Yooloo…
Yooloo!
Sands of Infinity!!!
Ohhhh!!!
Cookoo!!!
Oh Oh OHHHH!!!
Oh Oh OHHHH!!!
Quandamooka Yoolooburrabee Rise!
Quandamooka Yoolooburrabee Rise And Thrive!
Quandamooka Yoolooburrabee Rise And Thrive!!!
People of Sand and Sea... Rise And Thrive!!!
Ohhhh!!!
What a time to be alive!!!
Ohhhh!!!
What a time to be alive!!!
